bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 71
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 72
test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 73
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-dual-delivery-0f3633f"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 0f3633fd67b1c0c5faafdfa38924fd2e61369e6c || exit 74
python3 -B - "$root" "$stage" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,sys,os,subprocess,shutil
root,stage=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
path=root/"scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
before=path.read_text()
incoming=(stage/"scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py").read_text()
if "bug_report_inbox_provision" in before:
 print("USERBOT_LOCAL_PROVISION_ALREADY_PRESENT")
 sys.exit(76)
actions=re.search(r'^ACTIONS = frozenset\(\{.*\}\)$',before,re.M)
if actions is None or '"health"' not in actions.group(0):sys.exit(77)
block_start=incoming.find('    if action == "bug_report_inbox_provision":')
block_end=incoming.find('    if action == "profile_topics_readback":',block_start)
if block_start<0 or block_end<0:sys.exit(78)
block=incoming[block_start:block_end]
anchor='    if action == "profile_topics_readback":'
if before.count(anchor)!=1 or 'from userbot_session import SECRETS' not in before:sys.exit(79)
new=before[:actions.end()-2]+', "bug_report_inbox_provision"'+before[actions.end()-2:]
new=new.replace(anchor,block+anchor,1)
compile(new,str(path),"exec")
backup=root/"deploy/.userbot-code-backup-20261119"
backup.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
target=backup/"userbot_resident_ipc.before_dual_delivery.py"
if target.exists():sys.exit(80)
target.write_text(before)
target.chmod(0o600)
tmp=path.with_name(path.name+".bugdual.tmp")
if tmp.exists():sys.exit(81)
tmp.write_text(new)
tmp.chmod(path.stat().st_mode&0o777)
os.replace(tmp,path)
print("USERBOT_IPC_PATCH_APPLIED=YES")
PY
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 82
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 83
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 84
test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 85
(cd "$root/scripts" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B userbot_test_client.py health) || exit 86
(cd "$root/scripts" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B userbot_test_client.py bug_report_inbox_provision) || exit 87
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt" || exit 88
test "$(stat -c %a "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt")" = 600 || exit 89
echo USERBOT_PROVISION_PASS
